# Effects Reference Sheet

Source: [1993](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1993); edited 2023-10-01. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1993-n1"></a>

- Catalog separates Create Effect visual/audio choices from Play Effect visual/audio choices, helping avoid confusing persistent and one-shot asset families.

<a id="wiki-1993-n2"></a>

- Create visuals include Sphere/Light Shaft/Orb/Ring/Cloud/Sparkles/Good Aura/Bad Aura; create audio includes Energy/Pick-Up/Good Aura/Bad Aura/Sparkles/Smoke/Decal/Beacon.

<a id="wiki-1993-n3"></a>

- Play visuals include Good/Bad/Ring Explosion and Good/Bad Pickup; play audio includes Debuff/Buff Impact, Ring/Buff Explosion, Explosion. Beam effect/sound catalogs are linked separately.

Source limitations:

- October 2023 catalog is a preview index, not complete runtime semantics or a current enum authority.

- Visual appearance and sound require remote images/videos/audio; none fetched, so offline rewrite needs textual descriptions or optional media links.

Offline scope: Remote visual/audio previews are not available as offline factual text. Behavioral notes and named API assets are retained; no visual matching or numeric bounds are inferred from absent media.
